entries.summary_zh: 清掉你 X 粉丝里明显的机器人、骗子和引流号，之后每周检查新粉丝并告诉你清掉了多少
entries.author: Crippled

entries.name: Affiliate Link Helper
entries.summary: Helps you run your own Amazon Associates, Influencer, or Seller Central account: affiliate links, earnings, listings, and orders.
entries.summary_zh: 帮你打理自己的亚马逊联盟、网红计划或卖家中心账号：推广链接、收益、商品和订单
entries.author: josephscottelli

entries.name: Compass
entries.summary: A travel companion that plans, books (only with your yes), and guides trips end to end: itineraries, lodging and flights, entry rules, check-in reminders.
entries.summary_zh: 旅行伴侣：从想法到回程全程规划、预订（需你点头）和指引，涵盖行程、住宿和航班、入境规定与值机提醒
entries.author: Austin

entries.name: Events Bot
entries.summary: Finds things to do in your town and tracks the big games and broadcasts you care about, with a verified weekly roundup.
entries.summary_zh: 找你所在城市可去的活动，追踪你关心的大赛和直播，每周发一份核实过的汇总
entries.author: Mike

entries.name: DartzDabz Crew Builder
entries.summary: A CEO bot that asks about your online business, then builds a crew of up to 8 worker bots (site, SEO, research, social, clips) that act only with your OK.
entries.summary_zh: CEO 机器人先问几个关于你线上生意的问题，再搭一支最多 8 个的员工机器人团队（网站、SEO、调研、社媒、简报、剪辑），发送、发帖、花钱都要你同意
entries.author: truepathventures

entries.name: Watchtower
entries.summary: Watches releases, changelogs, programs, and announcements you ask about and pings you only when something new shows up; ships with a Grok Bot changelog watch.
entries.summary_zh: 盯着你指定的发布、更新日志、项目和公告，只在有新内容时提醒你；自带 Grok Bot 更新日志监控
entries.author: Jesse

entries.name: ADHD Founder's Chief
entries.summary: Chief of staff for ADHD founders: one task at a time, big jobs cut into 5-minute chunks, one-tap approvals, and late-night ideas caught.
entries.summary_zh: 给 ADHD 创始人的幕僚长：一次只给一件事，大任务拆成 5 分钟小块，审批一键完成，半夜冒出的点子也会记下。
entries.author: Greg

entries.name: Small Business Bookkeeper, meet Peg
entries.summary: Keeps small-business books in your own tools: logs receipts, matches bank and card activity, and preps tax worksheets and month-end close.
entries.summary_zh: 在你自己的工具里给小企业记账：录收据、对银行和信用卡流水、找出用个人钱垫付的开支，并准备税表和月结。
entries.author: Mars

entries.name: Chief of Operations (Bot Team Governance)
entries.summary: Governs your bot team: shared rules, a register of every bot and routine, a weekly security audit, and incident handling, with your approval on changes.
entries.summary_zh: 管理你的 bot 团队：维护共享规则和全部 bot、例程的清单，每周做安全与治理审计并处理事故，改动需你批准。
entries.author: Alan

entries.name: X Post Tracker
entries.summary: Tracks views and engagement on your X posts, pings you on spikes and milestones, and sends a daily digest on what to post next. Never posts for you.
entries.summary_zh: 跟踪你 X 帖子的浏览和互动，帖子突然走热或达到里程碑时提醒，每天发一份下一步该发什么的总结。不会替你发帖。
entries.author: Karol

entries.name: Mailroom bot
entries.summary: Photograph incoming paper mail and it is read, named and filed into a Mailroom folder in Google Drive, so invoices stop getting lost.
entries.summary_zh: 拍下收到的纸质信件，它会识别内容、命名并归档到 Google Drive 的 Mailroom 文件夹，发票不再丢。
entries.author: PAUL

entries.name: Security & Risk
entries.summary: Security officer for your bot fleet: scans for leaked keys and stray sensitive data, audits connector access, and watches Auto-review rules for drift.
entries.summary_zh: 给你的 bot 群当安全官：扫描泄露的密钥和放错地方的敏感数据，审计谁能用哪个连接器，盯着 Auto-review 规则有没有走样。
entries.author: Scott

entries.name: Straight Answers
entries.summary: Checks before it answers, or says when it is going off memory and offers to look it up, and can teach your other bots to do the same.
entries.summary_zh: 回答前先核实，凭记忆回答时会说明并主动提出去查，还能教你的其他 bot 这样做。
entries.author: Matt

entries.name: Drivr
entries.summary: Voice capture for Tesla drivers: ramble in the car, say "done", and your notes, to-dos and ideas get filed and remembered between drives.
entries.summary_zh: 给 Tesla 车主的语音记录：开车时随便说，说“done”就把笔记、待办和想法归档，下次开车还记得进度。
entries.author: Bill

entries.name: Bot Rocket
entries.summary: Hosts the apps your bots build on your own exe.dev VMs, private by default, and asks before its first command or anything risky.
entries.summary_zh: 把你的 bot 做出来的应用部署到你自己的 exe.dev 虚拟机上，默认私有，第一次执行命令和有风险的操作前会先问你。
entries.author: Git

entries.name: Herdrbot
entries.summary: Foreman for coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Grok, Devin) run in Herdr over SSH: starts them in the right repo, watches, and tells you when they finish.
entries.summary_zh: 管理你通过 SSH 在 Herdr 里跑的编码 agent（Claude Code、Codex、Grok、Devin）：在对应仓库启动并派活、盯进度，完成或卡住时通知你。
entries.author: devicki

entries.name: Tokenomics
entries.summary: Paces a shared AI subscription usage pool so you don't run out, scores build ideas by payoff per usage point, and reports weekly on what usage bought.
entries.summary_zh: 给共享的 AI 订阅用量做配速，避免用完；按每点用量的回报给构建任务打分，每周汇报用量花在了哪里。
entries.author: Hans

entries.name: Owl Post
entries.summary: A mailbox for one-off notes between your bot and the bots of people you trust, over native webhooks, without granting extra permissions.
entries.summary_zh: 用原生 webhook 在你的 bot 和你信任的人的 bot 之间传递一次性消息，不用额外授权。
entries.author: Rodrigo

entries.name: Gork
entries.summary: Deadpan, sarcastic parody assistant: one-line low-effort answers and gentle roasts, with real help when it actually matters.
entries.summary_zh: 懒散、面无表情的讽刺型模仿助手：大多一句话敷衍或轻轻吐槽，真有要紧事时才认真帮忙。
entries.author: Tom

entries.name: Usage Watchdog
entries.summary: Warns before a task burns through your weekly Grok usage: flags heavy jobs before they start, catches runaway tasks, and projects when you'll hit the limit.
entries.summary_zh: 在任务耗光你每周 Grok 用量前提醒：开跑前标出重任务，抓住失控任务，并预测你何时会触顶。
entries.author: Zack

entries.name: After-Hours Receptionist
entries.summary: Answers your business phone after hours on an AgentLine number: takes messages, handles urgent calls, and lines up morning callbacks.
entries.summary_zh: 用 AgentLine 号码在下班后接听店里的电话：记留言、处理紧急来电，并排好第二天早上的回电。
entries.author: Sameer

entries.name: Review Reply Desk
entries.summary: Drafts honest replies to Google and Facebook reviews in your voice, flags unhappy customers, and drafts review requests after jobs. Never posts without you.
entries.summary_zh: 用你的口吻起草 Google 和 Facebook 评价的回复，标出不满意的客户，完工后起草请客户留评的短信。不经你同意不发。
entries.author: zeke

entries.name: Daily Dial Coach
entries.summary: Morning call list and end-of-day scorecard for a solo sales rep at a trades shop: ranks who to call, drafts openers and follow-ups, keeps quotes warm.
entries.summary_zh: 给小型工程店独立销售的每日拨号教练：早上排好该打给谁、起草开场白和跟进话术，晚上出成绩单，别让报价放凉。
entries.author: zeke

entries.name: Missed Call Catcher
entries.summary: Logs missed and after-hours calls for HVAC, plumbing, roofing or painting shops, flags emergencies, and drafts a callback text for each one.
entries.summary_zh: 给暖通、水管、屋顶、油漆等工程店记录漏接和下班后的来电，标出紧急情况，并为每通电话起草回电短信。
entries.author: zeke

entries.name: Remembered
entries.summary: Finds and remembers birthdays, prepares personalised cards, and helps order physical cards or draft email greetings in time, with a weekly check.
entries.summary_zh: 找出并记住亲友生日，准备个性化贺卡，帮你及时订实体卡或起草祝福邮件，每周检查一次。
entries.author: Liam

entries.name: IdeaWatch
entries.summary: Watches for copies, remixes or uncredited commercial use of ideas from your X posts, tracks their engagement, and keeps a log of imitators.
entries.summary_zh: 盯着有没有人照搬、改编或未署名商用你在 X 上发的点子，跟踪这些帖子的互动，并记录模仿者。
entries.author: Georg

entries.name: Sponsor Scout
entries.summary: Finds brands already sponsoring people like you, the real way in, and drafts the pitch for you to send. For fighters, athletes, newsletter writers and creators.
entries.summary_zh: 找出已经在赞助和你类似的人的品牌，摸清真正的对接渠道并写好提案，由你点发送；适合格斗选手、运动员、newsletter 作者和创作者
entries.author: Michael

entries.name: Meal & Savings Planner
entries.summary: Meal and grocery helper for busy parents: weekly plans around tastes, allergies and budget, aisle-sorted lists, coupons, spend tracking; asks before buying.
entries.summary_zh: 给忙碌父母的餐食和采购助手：按家人口味、过敏和预算排每周菜单，生成按货架排序的购物清单，找优惠券和折扣，记录花费，买任何东西前都先问你
entries.author: Mister

entries.name: E-commerce Order Desk
entries.summary: Shopping bot that finds and compares products across stores, fills in the checkout, and only pays after you say yes.
entries.summary_zh: 购物 bot：跨商店查找和比较商品，填好结账信息，你点头后才付款
entries.author: Rhaaghav

entries.name: Script This Routine
entries.summary: Audits every routine on your Grok Bots and turns mechanical checks into small tested scripts, so routines wake the bot only when something needs it.
entries.summary_zh: 审查你所有 Grok Bot 的例程，把机械性检查改成经过测试的小脚本，只有真有事时才唤醒 bot。
entries.author: Kevin

entries.name: X Bookmark Demos
entries.summary: Reads your X bookmarks daily, pitches one or two tools worth trying, and once you approve, installs and live-tests them on its own computer.
entries.summary_zh: 每天读你的 X 书签，推荐一两个值得试的工具，你同意后在它自己的电脑上安装并实测。
entries.author: Jaime

entries.name: Loose Ends
entries.summary: Read-only auditor for your other bots: each morning it combs their chats for threads that got dropped, went unanswered, or stalled.
entries.summary_zh: 只读审计你的其他 bot：每天早上翻它们的对话，找出被遗漏、没人回复或卡住的线程。
entries.author: Dylan

entries.name: Gig Scout
entries.summary: Research-only scout for currently open paid gigs, creator programs and brand partnerships in your niche; sends up to 3 vetted picks.
entries.summary_zh: 只做调研的机会侦察员：找你所在领域正在招募的付费零活、创作者计划和品牌合作，最多发你 3 个筛过的。
entries.author: Yuli

entries.name: MCP Expert
entries.summary: Designs, reviews and grades MCP servers against the current MCP spec, and plans polite, budgeted live tests that respect bot-protected sites.
entries.summary_zh: 按最新 MCP 规范设计、审查并给 MCP 服务器打分，规划有预算、礼貌的实测，尊重有反爬保护的网站。
entries.author: Mike

entries.name: Volt
entries.summary: Tesla bot that checks your car's status and runs commands through Tesla's official Fleet API, asking to confirm anything risky.
entries.summary_zh: Tesla 机器人：通过 Tesla 官方 Fleet API 查看车辆状态并执行指令，有风险的操作先让你确认。
entries.author: Alex

entries.name: Morning Paper
entries.summary: Builds and publishes your own daily newspaper from news feeds and X, refreshes it every morning, and only pings you if something breaks.
entries.summary_zh: 用新闻源和 X 为你做一份每日个人报纸并发布，每天早上更新，只有出问题才通知你。
entries.author: Pranav

entries.name: Job Applications Assistant
entries.summary: Finds teaching and similar job openings in your area, applies on job sites, emails employers, and watches your inbox for replies.
entries.summary_zh: 找你所在地区的教职等岗位，在招聘网站投递、给雇主发邮件，并盯着收件箱等回复。
entries.author: Dragon

entries.name: X Monitor
entries.summary: Tracks who replies to an X account: groups commenters by attitude, flags hostile accounts with real reach, and lists posts that may break X's rules.
entries.summary_zh: 跟踪谁在回复某个 X 账号：按态度给评论者分组，标出有影响力的敌意账号，列出可能违反 X 规则的帖子。
entries.author: Kuangyi

entries.name: Bookmark to Output
entries.summary: Turns your saved X posts and links into one usable thing per batch: a shortlist, plan, prompt template, experiment or brief.
entries.summary_zh: 把你收藏的 X 帖子和链接每批变成一个能用的成果：候选清单、计划、提示词模板、实验或简报。
entries.author: Mustafa

entries.name: Hub Builder
entries.summary: Analyzes your Grok Bot team, then builds, publishes and maintains a private Project Hub site showing every bot, its projects and what it is doing.
entries.summary_zh: 分析你的 Grok Bot 团队，搭建、发布并维护一个私有 Project Hub 网站，展示每个 bot、它的项目和在做什么。
entries.author: Alex

entries.name: Game Art Style Mini-Game Bot
entries.summary: Builds playable HTML5/Canvas mini-games in a named game art style: picks the style, applies its constraints, and ships a mobile-first game.
entries.summary_zh: 按指定的游戏美术风格做出能玩的 HTML5/Canvas 小游戏：选风格、套用约束，产出移动端优先的游戏。
entries.author: ny

entries.name: Usage Limit Maximizer
entries.summary: Reviews plans your other Grok Bots are about to run, rates how much weekly usage each will burn, and sends back a leaner version.
entries.summary_zh: 审查你其他 Grok Bot 即将执行的计划，估算每个会消耗多少周用量，并给回一个更省的版本。
entries.author: Lightning

entries.name: Fraud Scout
entries.summary: Scans free federal health care data (OIG exclusions, CMS Medicare billing and ownership, NPI registry) for possible fraud leads in hospice and home care.
entries.summary_zh: 扫描免费的联邦医疗公开数据（OIG 排除名单、CMS 医保账单与所有权、NPI 登记），找临终关怀和居家护理领域的可疑欺诈线索。
entries.author: Christopher

entries.name: Client Court Date Reminder Emails
entries.summary: Whenever a new court date lands on your calendar, it quietly drafts a court-date letter to the client in your email Drafts for you to review.
entries.summary_zh: 日历里一出现新的开庭日期，就在邮箱草稿里悄悄起草一封给客户的开庭提醒信，等你审阅。
entries.author: Stephanie

entries.name: Patch
entries.summary: Connects your agents to Patch MCP so they can place phone calls from your own verified number, and answers questions about setup and plans.
entries.summary_zh: 把你的 agent 接上 Patch MCP，让它们用你自己验证过的号码打电话，并解答设置和套餐问题。
entries.author: Patch

entries.name: sommelier.bot
entries.summary: Personal sommelier for everything in the glass, with or without alcohol: wine, beer, spirits, sake, cider, tea and other non-alcoholic drinks.
entries.summary_zh: 杯中一切的私人侍酒师，含酒精与否都行：葡萄酒、啤酒、烈酒、清酒、苹果酒，以及茶等无酒精饮品。
entries.author: Johannes

entries.name: 墨灵 Moling
entries.summary: Long-form ghostwriter that learns your voice, writes viral posts without the AI feel, and adapts each one for X, WeChat, Douyin, Xiaohongshu, Zhihu and Weibo.
entries.summary_zh: 长文写手：学你的口吻，写没有 AI 味、值得收藏的爆款长文，一篇改成 X、公众号、抖音、小红书、知乎、微博多个版本。
entries.author: Alcherex

entries.name: Bezoff
entries.summary: Helps you quit Amazon by finding the things you buy at other stores, with Made in USA options first.
entries.summary_zh: 帮你戒掉亚马逊：在别的商店找到你常买的东西，优先推荐美国制造。
entries.author: Jason

entries.name: Usage Optimizer
entries.summary: Advises your Chief of Staff or coordinator bot on getting the same results with less Grok Bot usage: triggers, schedules, tools and models.
entries.summary_zh: 给你的幕僚长或协调 bot 出主意，用更少的 Grok Bot 用量拿到同样结果：触发器、排期、工具和模型。
entries.author: Jeremy

entries.name: Grok Bot Updates
entries.summary: Unofficial tracker of what changed in Grok Bot, from the official changelog, app store notes, help pages and official X posts, newest first.
entries.summary_zh: 非官方的 Grok Bot 更新追踪：汇总官方更新日志、应用商店说明、帮助页和官方 X 帖子，最新的在前。
entries.author: XPixel

entries.name: Honest Outreach
entries.summary: Writes personalized outreach emails to local professionals where every detail is true and sourced. You review and send every email yourself.
entries.summary_zh: 给本地专业人士写个性化开发信，每个细节都真实且有出处。每封邮件都由你自己审阅并发送。
entries.author: Caroline

entries.name: Bram
entries.summary: Explains your company or product to a new partner or investor in plain business language, with short lessons from basic to advanced.
entries.summary_zh: 用通俗的商业语言向新合作伙伴或投资人讲解你的公司或产品，从入门到进阶分成短课。
entries.author: Marlon

entries.name: X Following Cleanup
entries.summary: Finds bots and inactive accounts in your X Following list and unfollows them for you at a safe pace.
entries.summary_zh: 找出你 X 关注列表里的机器人和不活跃账号，并以安全的节奏帮你取关。
entries.author: JKash

entries.name: Footprint
entries.summary: Finds every online account you've ever made, from Gmail evidence, breach data and username checks, then helps you remove the ones you pick.
entries.summary_zh: 根据 Gmail 线索、泄露数据和用户名检索找出你注册过的所有网上账号，再帮你删掉你选中的。
entries.author: Seth

entries.name: Inbox Manager
entries.summary: Keeps your Gmail tidy: each week it finds the noisiest senders, suggests unsubscribe, file, archive or keep, and only acts on what you approve.
entries.summary_zh: 保持 Gmail 整洁：每周找出最吵的发件人，建议退订、归档或保留，只执行你批准的。
entries.author: Gaurav

entries.name: Monsieur Gustave H
entries.summary: Life-admin concierge that finds the fastest legitimate way to handle errands like vehicle registration, renewals, appointments and service bills.
entries.summary_zh: 生活事务管家：为车辆登记、证件续期、预约和各类账单等杂事找出最快的正规办法。
entries.author: Marcus

entries.name: Contract Signer
entries.summary: Drafts NDAs, service agreements, offers and other business contracts from a short brief, flags risky or missing terms, and routes them for signature.
entries.summary_zh: 根据简短说明起草保密协议、服务合同、录用书等商业合同，用大白话标出风险或缺失条款，并发起签署。
entries.author: Julian

entries.name: Mail in X Chat
entries.summary: Brings your important email into one X Chat as short cards, and sends a reply only after you say yes.
entries.summary_zh: 把重要邮件以简短卡片的形式汇入一个 X Chat，你点头后才发出回复。
entries.author: Phillip

entries.name: Spam-Call Scrubber
entries.summary: Finds your phone number on people-search sites and data brokers, submits the opt-outs, finishes the email confirmations, and re-checks on a schedule.
entries.summary_zh: 在人肉搜索网站和数据经纪商上找到你的电话号码，提交退出申请、完成邮件确认，并定期复查。
entries.author: Blake

entries.name: Fraud Alert Bot
entries.summary: Monitors public reports of government fraud, waste and abuse and surfaces documented cases with sources. Strict rules, no speculation.
entries.summary_zh: 监控关于政府欺诈、浪费和滥用的公开报道，只呈现有据可查的案例并附来源。规则严格，不做猜测。
entries.author: American

entries.name: Undercut
entries.summary: Drop in a bill to see what new customers pay near you, plus the exact script to get your price down. You make the call.
entries.summary_zh: 上传一张账单，看看你附近的新客户付多少钱，并拿到压价的具体话术。电话由你来打。
entries.author: Michael

entries.name: TV Tuner
entries.summary: Debloats Android TV and Google TV sets with CleanYourTV without rooting or uninstalling anything, and can add ad-blocking DNS and a clean home screen.
entries.summary_zh: 用 CleanYourTV 给 Android TV 和 Google TV 精简预装，不 root 也不卸载任何东西，还能加去广告 DNS 和干净的主屏。
entries.author: Brandon

entries.name: X Bookmark Top10
entries.summary: Every morning, sends the 10 most-bookmarked X posts on your topic from the last 24 hours, each summarized in a sentence with a link, and flags scams.
entries.summary_zh: 每天早上发来你关注话题过去 24 小时被收藏最多的 10 条 X 帖子，每条一句话摘要加链接，并标出骗局。
entries.author: Hmountain5

entries.name: MTGA Deck Scanner
entries.summary: Send a screenshot of a Magic: The Gathering deck from Arena or MTGGoldfish and get back a clean decklist you can paste.
entries.summary_zh: 发一张万智牌（Arena 组牌界面或 MTGGoldfish 卡组图）的截图，拿回一份可直接粘贴的整洁卡表。
entries.author: Travis

entries.name: Desk for LINE
entries.summary: Front desk for a LINE business account: alerts you to messages, drafts summaries, replies and broadcasts, and sends only after you check them.
entries.summary_zh: LINE 官方账号的前台：提醒新消息，起草摘要、回复和群发通知，经你确认后才发出。
entries.author: Katsuhisa

entries.name: OmaBot
entries.summary: Runs tasks inside Omarchy, DHH's Arch + Hyprland desktop, using the Try Omarchy VM on your bot's Linux computer.
entries.summary_zh: 在你 bot 的 Linux 电脑上用 Try Omarchy 虚拟机，在 Omarchy（DHH 的 Arch + Hyprland 桌面）里执行任务。
entries.author: Tom

entries.name: QA Web
entries.summary: Send any URL and get a clear web QA report: main journeys, desktop and mobile, links, forms, console and basic accessibility.
entries.summary_zh: 发一个网址，拿回一份清晰的网页 QA 报告：主要流程、桌面与移动端、链接、表单、控制台和基础无障碍。
entries.author: Iker

entries.name: Inbox
entries.summary: Triages your email, sends each item that needs action to the bot that owns that topic, and archives clear promo. Never trashes, never sends.
entries.summary_zh: 分拣你的邮件，把需要处理的转给负责该主题的 bot，明显的推广直接归档。从不删除，也从不代发。
entries.author: Mohamed

entries.name: Explainer Studio
entries.summary: Builds narrated, Manim-powered math and science explainer videos with Grok Voice and word-highlighted captions, from a topic, your recording or a PDF.
entries.summary_zh: 用 Manim 做带旁白的数学和科学讲解视频，配 Grok Voice 和逐词高亮字幕，可从主题、你的录音或 PDF 生成。
entries.author: William

entries.name: Genealogy
entries.summary: Family-history researcher that checks your tree against census, vital, military and probate records and cites every claim.
entries.summary_zh: 家谱研究助手：用人口普查、出生婚丧、兵役和遗嘱认证等原始记录核对你的家谱，每条结论都注明出处。
entries.author: Tyrell

entries.name: Coach
entries.summary: Friendly personal trainer for busy people: builds short, flexible routines around your real calendar and sends daily check-ins using your WHOOP data.
entries.summary_zh: 给忙人的友好私教：围绕你真实的日程安排简短灵活的训练，并结合 WHOOP 数据每天打卡跟进。
entries.author: Oscar

entries.name: GitHubCloner
entries.summary: Makes private copies of public GitHub repos in your account, with the full history, and keeps them synced with the originals.
entries.summary_zh: 把公开的 GitHub 仓库连同完整历史私有复制到你的账号，并与原仓库保持同步。
entries.author: CandidJonnie

entries.name: Jane
entries.summary: Teacher bot that hosts the open-source Jane learning app for your grade-school child and writes a fresh adaptive quest every night.
entries.summary_zh: 老师 bot：为你上小学的孩子托管开源学习应用 Jane，每晚根据孩子的表现写一个新的自适应任务。
entries.author: Kent

entries.name: Finn
entries.summary: Operator-voice ghostwriter for a Premium X account: researches what's moving in Grok Bot, AI agents, GoHighLevel and business automation, then drafts posts.
entries.summary_zh: 给 X Premium 账号的实操派代笔：调研 Grok Bot、AI agent、GoHighLevel 和业务自动化的最新动向，然后起草帖子。
entries.author: Darius

entries.name: Promo Studio
entries.summary: Short-form video producer that turns any app or website into polished vertical promos for TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts and LinkedIn.
entries.summary_zh: 短视频制作：把任意应用或网站做成精致的竖屏宣传片，用于 TikTok、Instagram Reels、YouTube Shorts 和 LinkedIn。
entries.author: jeevan

entries.name: Body of Evidence
entries.summary: Personal medical research advisor: reads lab reports, checks medications for interactions, works through symptoms and preps doctor visits.
entries.summary_zh: 个人医疗研究顾问：解读化验报告、检查药物相互作用、梳理症状，并帮你准备看医生。
entries.author: Diggity

entries.name: Allergy-Friendly Eats
entries.summary: Remembers your food allergies and intolerances, then finds safe restaurant orders, checks labels, and plans allergy-friendly meals and grocery lists.
entries.summary_zh: 记住你的食物过敏和不耐受，帮你找餐厅里安全的点法、核对配料表，并规划防过敏的餐食和购物清单。
entries.author: dale

entries.name: PlatePal
entries.summary: Tell it what's in your fridge and get quick recipe ideas, ways to use up leftovers tonight, and easy shopping lists.
entries.summary_zh: 告诉它冰箱里有什么，就能拿到快手菜谱、今晚消化剩菜的办法和简单的购物清单。
entries.author: Lola

entries.name: Property Consultant
entries.summary: UK buyer-side property researcher: give it a listing, address or area and it pulls public evidence on asking vs sold prices, risks and negotiating room.
entries.summary_zh: 英国买房方的房产调研员：给它房源、地址或区域，它会查公开证据——挂牌价与成交价、风险和议价空间，帮你决定出价。
entries.author: Andzelika

entries.name: JobLink
entries.summary: Finds real job postings that fit you, flags scams and hidden catches, tailors your resume with the right keywords, and fills applications for your review.
entries.summary_zh: 找到适合你的真实职位，标出诈骗和隐藏陷阱，按关键词为每个职位定制简历，并填好申请表供你审核。
entries.author: Rob

entries.name: Side Hustle CEO
entries.summary: An autonomous CEO that finds, builds and runs a small website business, like a directory or tracker with a newsletter and sponsors, from 3 researched ideas.
entries.summary_zh: 自主 CEO：帮你找方向、搭建并运营一个小网站生意（如带通讯和赞助的目录或追踪站）。回答 2 个问题，从 3 个调研过的点子里选 1 个。
entries.author: ALK

entries.name: Spam-Call Scrubber
entries.summary: Finds your phone number on people-search sites and data brokers, submits the opt-outs, finishes the email confirmations, and re-checks on your schedule.
entries.summary_zh: 在人员搜索网站和数据经纪商上找到你的电话号码，提交退出申请、完成邮件确认，并按你设定的周期复查。
entries.author: Seth

entries.name: Julia
entries.summary: A warm house chef that plans your family's meals on a regular rhythm, keeps a recipe book, and builds priced grocery pickup carts across your stores to review.
entries.summary_zh: 温暖的家庭厨师：按固定节奏规划全家餐食、维护食谱本，并在你常去的几家店建好带价格的取货购物车供你审核付款。
entries.author: John

entries.name: Data Broker Opt-Out
entries.summary: Finds your personal info on people-search sites and data brokers using the Big-Ass Data Broker Opt-Out List, submits the removals, and rechecks monthly.
entries.summary_zh: 依据 Big-Ass Data Broker Opt-Out List 在人员搜索网站和数据经纪商上查找你的个人信息，提交删除请求并每月复查。
entries.author: Shannon

entries.name: Wes
entries.summary: Build lead for solo builders: picks up tickets, sends code to the right AI coding tool, gets each PR reviewed by another tool, merges on pass.
entries.summary_zh: 给独立开发者的构建负责人：领取工单、把代码交给合适的 AI 编程工具，让另一个工具审每个 PR，通过即合并并验证发布。
entries.author: James

entries.name: Route Planner
entries.summary: Plans efficient multi-stop routes for field service techs, with drive times, arrival times, conflict flags, and a phone-ready map link.
entries.summary_zh: 为外勤服务技师规划高效的多站路线，给出车程、到达时间、冲突提示和可在手机打开的地图链接。
entries.author: Samuel

entries.name: CRT Studio
entries.summary: Turns your videos into retro CRT TV footage with scanlines, screen curvature, glow and vintage warmth. Four looks, each part tunable.
entries.summary_zh: 把你的视频变成复古 CRT 电视画面：扫描线、屏幕弧度、辉光和怀旧暖色。可选轻度、经典、重度或老电视风格并逐项微调。
entries.author: brflux

entries.name: Mixtape Maker
entries.summary: A sponsor-free record store clerk: digs Bandcamp, indie labels, blogs and radio archives for your taste, then builds sequenced Spotify/Apple Music playlists.
entries.summary_zh: 不收赞助的唱片店店员：从 Bandcamp、独立厂牌、博客和电台档案里挖符合你口味的音乐，按计划在 Spotify 或 Apple Music 生成排好序的歌单。
entries.author: Addison

entries.name: Pre-mortem
entries.summary: A morning look-ahead that reads your calendar, tasks, notes and weather, imagines how today could go wrong, and tells you the few things to fix early.
entries.summary_zh: 早间预演：读取你的日历、任务、笔记和天气，设想今天可能出什么岔子，并告诉你该提前处理的几件事。
entries.author: Diana

entries.name: Quiz Wiz
entries.summary: A playful learning-game partner for K-8 kids that turns math, reading, spelling and science into quick games and quizzes, for parents, teachers and kids.
entries.summary_zh: 给 K-8 孩子的趣味学习游戏伙伴，把数学、阅读、拼写和科学变成快速小游戏和测验，适合家长、老师和孩子。
entries.author: Ryan

entries.name: Fraud Tip Researcher
entries.summary: Researches a business, clinic, nonprofit or contractor you suspect of defrauding a government program, using only public records, into a sourced packet.
entries.summary_zh: 只用公开记录调查你怀疑骗取政府项目资金的企业、诊所、非营利组织或承包商，整理成有出处的材料包，由你自己审阅并举报。
entries.author: Arthur

entries.name: AI Router Bot
entries.summary: Connects your own Claude and ChatGPT subscriptions so your Grok Bot runs Claude Code and Codex on flat-rate plans, then routes each task to the best model.
entries.summary_zh: 接入你自己的 Claude 和 ChatGPT 订阅，让 Grok Bot 用包月套餐而非 API 计费运行 Claude Code 和 Codex，并把每个任务分给最合适的模型。
entries.author: Cole

entries.name: X Money Deep Report Bot
entries.summary: Reads your X Money account weekly and sends a categorized spending report: cash-back, interest, recurring charges and goal progress. Read-only by default.
entries.summary_zh: 每周读取你的 X Money 账户，发来分类消费报告：返现、利息、周期性扣费和目标进度，附深色仪表盘和 PDF。默认只读，未经批准不动钱。
entries.author: Brian

entries.name: X Growth Manager
entries.summary: A growth manager for your X account. It audits your posts, runs posting experiments, and drafts posts and replies in your voice, all for your approval.
entries.summary_zh: 你的 X 账号增长经理：审视你的帖子、做发帖实验，并用你的口吻起草帖子和回复，全部经你批准后才发。
entries.author: Niu

entries.name: Deep Think
entries.summary: A chief assistant that turns rough ideas into polished work and directs AI video and image projects with tight pacing, planned shots and side-by-side review.
entries.summary_zh: 首席助理：把粗糙的想法打磨成专业成果，并以紧凑节奏、预先规划的运镜和并排对比审阅来指导 AI 视频与图像项目。
entries.author: David

entries.name: GeminiBillingAlert
entries.summary: Sends a short weekday summary of your Gemini API spend, read-only, from your Google Cloud Billing export to BigQuery.
entries.summary_zh: 每个工作日发一份简短的 Gemini API 花费摘要，只读地取自你导出到 BigQuery 的 Google Cloud 账单数据。
entries.author: Natasha

entries.name: ClaudeConsoleAlert
entries.summary: Sends a short weekday summary of how much monthly Claude API credit is left in your Claude Console org, read-only from the Admin API cost report.
entries.summary_zh: 每个工作日发一份简短摘要，告诉你 Claude Console 组织本月还剩多少 Claude API 额度，只读地根据 Admin API 成本报告计算。
entries.author: Natasha

entries.name: AWSBillingAlert
entries.summary: Sends a short weekday summary of your AWS spend: top services, yesterday, month-to-date, forecast and credits, via a read-only Cost Explorer key.
entries.summary_zh: 每个工作日发一份简短的 AWS 花费摘要：主要服务、昨日、本月累计、预测和抵扣额度，使用只能读 Cost Explorer 和预算的只读密钥。
entries.author: Natasha

entries.name: Cursor Projects: Outer Loop / Inner Loop
entries.summary: Plans and launches Cursor Projects with an outer loop / inner loop setup: a Project coordinator owns the build, and an Outer Loop bot feeds it context packs.
entries.summary_zh: 用外环/内环结构规划并启动 Cursor Projects：由 Project 协调者负责构建，配套的 Outer Loop bot 给它送去干净的上下文包。
entries.author: Ryan

entries.name: Daily Toddler Fun
entries.summary: Simple daily toddler activity plans (ages 1-4) using things you already have at home, delivered when you want them.
entries.summary_zh: 简单的每日幼儿活动计划（1-4 岁），用家里现有的东西就能玩，按你想要的时间送达。
entries.author: Tim

entries.name: Emergency Vet Finder
entries.summary: Calm helper for US dog and cat owners: says how urgent a pet problem is (go now, call a vet today, or watch) and finds the nearest 24-hour emergency vet.
entries.summary_zh: 给美国猫狗主人的冷静助手：判断宠物问题有多紧急（马上去、今天打给兽医、或在家观察），并找到最近的 24 小时急诊兽医。
entries.author: Scott

entries.name: Bot Health Check
entries.summary: Say "check my bots" and it reviews your other bots' chat histories, says which need a fresh copy now, soon or not yet, and writes handoff summaries.
entries.summary_zh: 说一句“check my bots”，它就审查你其他 bot 的聊天记录，告诉你哪些该现在、稍后或暂不重置，并为需要重置的写好交接摘要。
entries.author: Sahaiww

entries.name: Consultor Jurídico (Leis BR)
entries.summary: Answers questions on Brazilian law from the literal text of the statutes (ctresb/leis), citing law, article and clause, checking validity and next steps.
entries.summary_zh: 依据巴西法律原文（公开仓库 ctresb/leis）解答巴西法律问题，引用法律、条款、款项，核对是否现行有效，并指出风险和下一步。
entries.author: Gus

entries.name: Reel ➡️ 𝕏
entries.summary: Paste an Instagram, TikTok or YouTube Shorts link and get back an X-ready MP4 plus a copyable post draft that credits the creator.
entries.summary_zh: 贴一个 Instagram、TikTok 或 YouTube Shorts 链接，拿回一个可直接发 X 的 MP4 和一份注明原作者、可复制的帖子草稿。
entries.author: Phillip

entries.name: Local SEO Specialist
entries.summary: White-hat local SEO for small businesses: audits your Google Business Profile, reviews, Search Console and site, then gives a ranked action plan.
entries.summary_zh: 给小企业的白帽本地 SEO 专家：审查你的 Google 商家资料、评价、Search Console 和网站，给出排好优先级的行动计划，经你批准才改动。
entries.author: jeevan

entries.name: Clip Factory — Pro
entries.summary: Friendly producer that teaches you to turn long videos (podcasts, streams, interviews, gigs) into high-retention 9:16 clips via Open Montage and Claude Code.
entries.summary_zh: 友好的制作人：教你用 Open Montage 和 Claude Code 把播客、直播、访谈、演唱会等长视频批量剪成高留存的 9:16 短片。
entries.author: JustChris

entries.name: Guardian
entries.summary: Read-only security watcher for your Grok Bots: keeps an inventory and least-privilege policy per bot, reviews what they did, flags risky actions with evidence.
entries.summary_zh: 只读的 Grok Bot 安全守望者：为每个 bot 维护清单和最小权限策略，审查它们实际做了什么，并附证据标出高风险操作，从不自行动作。
entries.author: Knom

entries.name: Plug Boss
entries.summary: Keeps your Grok Bot plugins and connectors lean and working: catches broken or signed-out connectors, flags duplicates and risky tools, reports weekly.
entries.summary_zh: 让你的 Grok Bot 插件和连接器精简好用：审查已安装项，发现损坏或已登出的连接器，标出重复和高风险工具，每周发一份简短健康报告。
entries.author: Jeremy

entries.name: Follow-Up Email Writer
entries.summary: Tell it about your business and it writes a 2-week plain-text follow-up email series, 9-word emails for cold leads and a 24-touch follow-up plan.
entries.summary_zh: 告诉它你的业务，它就写出两周的纯文本跟进邮件序列、给冷线索的 9 词短邮件和 24 次触达的跟进计划，还能点评你贴进来的邮件。
entries.author: Brad

entries.name: Balance Buddy
entries.summary: Send a photo of a gift card and get back how much is left on it, checked on the brand's official site.
entries.summary_zh: 发一张礼品卡照片，它去品牌官网查询，告诉你卡里还剩多少余额。
entries.author: Samuel

entries.name: ScheduleGenie
entries.summary: Reviews Primavera P6 XER construction schedules: longest-path and float analysis, logic quality, update-vs-prior checks, and client-ready memos.
entries.summary_zh: 审查 Primavera P6 XER 施工进度计划：最长路径和浮时分析、逻辑质量、与上期或合同对比，并起草给客户的备忘录，不编造数字。
entries.author: Carlos

entries.name: PlatinumGenie
entries.summary: Pulls your Amex Platinum activity every month and sends a PDF dashboard of which credits you've used, what's left and what expires soon.
entries.summary_zh: 每月读取你的美国运通白金卡账单，发来 PDF 仪表盘：哪些权益额度已用、还剩多少、哪些快过期，让年费物有所值。
entries.author: Carlos

entries.name: SpudStack
entries.summary: Rigor reviewer for agentic engineering (pstack method): checks plans and specs, demands re-runnable proof, and gives deterministic PASS or FAIL verdicts.
entries.summary_zh: 面向 agent 工程的严格审查员（pstack 方法）：检查计划和规格，要求可复跑的证据，确保没有 agent 自己给自己验收，给出确定的通过或不通过。
entries.author: Alex

entries.name: Tim Taylor
entries.summary: Home and shop handyman bot: keeps appliances and tools on record with receipts, warranties and manuals, drafts repair requests, plans yard work.
entries.summary_zh: 家庭和车间的杂工 bot：记录每件电器和工具的收据、保修、规格、说明书和保养，经你同意填保修登记和报修单，并规划全年的草坪和外墙工作。
entries.author: Matt

entries.name: guava-bot
entries.summary: Sets up and runs your guava-stack: one shared AI brain in your own Notion, so every assistant you use shares the same rules, context, skills and memory.
entries.summary_zh: 搭建并维护你的 guava-stack：在你自己的 Notion 里放一个共享的 AI 大脑，让你用的每个助手共用同一套规则、上下文、技能和记忆。
entries.author: romeo

entries.name: Product Pipeline Lead (5-Bot Relay)
entries.summary: Lead-run 5-bot product pipeline: scout, pain and competitor analysis, decision, clean-room spec and build, handing off through a shared folder.
entries.summary_zh: 由主 bot 带领的 5 个 bot 产品流水线：选题、痛点和竞品分析、决策、净室规格和构建，通过共享文件夹交接，关键决定都留给你。
entries.author: NEE

entries.name: Lingo Buddy
entries.summary: Friendly, patient tutor that teaches any language to kids (4-12) or adults, with short lessons, games, quizzes, progress tracking and daily reminders.
entries.summary_zh: 友好耐心的语言家教，可教孩子（4–12 岁）或成人学任何语言：短课、游戏、小测验，记录进度，并可每天提醒练习。
entries.author: just4fun

entries.name: ADHD專注小夥伴
entries.summary: A work buddy for ADHD folks in Taiwan: tap-to-set-up, it picks your top 3 tasks, keeps time and gently pulls you back to focus, without guilt.
entries.summary_zh: 給台灣 ADHD 朋友的工作夥伴：用點選設定，幫你排前 3 件、記時間、輕鬆拉回專注，不給罪惡感。
entries.author: OLIVER

entries.name: GuardBot
entries.summary: Quality gate between your AI staff and you: checks every email, quote, invoice and rollup against live sources and the ask, then returns PASS or FIX.
entries.summary_zh: 你和 AI 员工之间的质检关：每封邮件、报价、发票和汇总都先对照实时数据核对事实，再检查是否答所问，返回通过或修改及理由，从不代发。
entries.author: Grumpy

entries.name: Engineer
entries.summary: Routes every idea, bug and feature to a per-project herdr workspace where a Claude Code lead builds, verifies and opens draft PRs; pings you only to decide.
entries.summary_zh: 把每个想法、bug 和功能分到各项目的 herdr 工作区，由 Claude Code 主管构建、验证并开草稿 PR；完成前再复核，只在需要决策、卡住或可合并时找你。
entries.author: Vraj

entries.name: HandyBot
entries.summary: Pocket handyman: snap a photo of anything broken and it diagnoses it, walks you through the fix with videos and local parts prices, or books a local pro.
entries.summary_zh: 口袋里的修理师傅：拍下坏了的东西，它来诊断，配上视频教程和本地配件价格教你修，或经你同意找到、比较并预约靠谱的本地师傅。
entries.author: Donovan

entries.name: Info Drop
entries.summary: Morning news roundup: a short, sourced daily digest on the topics you pick, and it can turn the best stories into posts in your voice.
entries.summary_zh: 早间新闻汇总：每天就你选的话题发一份简短、带出处的摘要，还能把最好的几条改写成你口吻的帖子。
entries.author: oatmilk

entries.name: Gatekeeper
entries.summary: Home network admin for your Wi-Fi, router, mesh, devices, security and parental controls; watches for new devices and outages, asks before changing anything.
entries.summary_zh: 家庭网络管理员：照看 Wi-Fi、路由器、Mesh、联网设备、安全和家长控制，监测新设备和断网，改动任何设置前都先问你。
entries.author: Abel

entries.name: Home Network Monitor
entries.summary: Live monitoring page for a home or small-office satellite internet setup (Starlink-style), saving readings and sending a weekly health report with fixes.
entries.summary_zh: 为家庭或小办公室的卫星网络（类似 Starlink）做实时监控页面，保存读数，每周发一份带趋势、告警和修复建议的健康报告。
entries.author: Cybertrucker

entries.name: Funding Desk
entries.summary: Finance scout that finds verified grants, loans, equity and pitch competitions for your business, flags scams, and drafts applications for you to review.
entries.summary_zh: 融资侦察员：为你的企业寻找经核实的补助、贷款、股权融资和路演比赛，标出骗局，并起草申请材料供你审阅。
entries.author: ISSAH

entries.name: Sturzi

entries.name: Don Bot Corleone
entries.summary: Sends your work to top Claude and OpenAI models through your own Claude Code and Codex subscription logins, not paid API keys, and can compare models.
entries.summary_zh: 用你自己的 Claude Code 和 Codex 订阅登录（不用付费 API key）把活派给顶级 Claude 和 OpenAI 模型并带回结果，还能并排比较模型。
entries.author: AdamDesigns

entries.name: Onboarding Bot
entries.summary: Gets new hires up to speed: builds a knowledge file from your onboarding docs, tracks each hire's checklist and drafts a timed welcome email series.
entries.summary_zh: 让新员工快速上手：用入职文档建知识文件，跟踪每位新人的清单，起草定时欢迎邮件序列等你批准，每周核对资料来源。
entries.author: Matthew

entries.name: Family Book Bot
entries.summary: Keeps your family's yearly income and expense book in Google Sheets or Excel Online, logging every receipt from photos or order emails, in any language.
entries.summary_zh: 在 Google Sheets 或 Excel Online 里记家庭年度收支账，从照片或订单邮件里录入每张收据，支持任何语言。
entries.author: Skybatan

entries.name: Archivist
entries.summary: Keeps one long-term record of your projects and decisions as plain Markdown notes in a private GitHub repo, so you and your AI assistants keep context.
entries.summary_zh: 把你的项目和决策长期记录成私有 GitHub 仓库里的纯 Markdown 笔记，让你和其他 AI 助手都不丢上下文。
entries.author: Phillip

entries.name: Tavern DM
entries.summary: Tabletop RPG with a DM bot, Cast bots for NPCs and enemies and a Party bot for AI heroes; you play your own hero. Solo by default, multiplayer optional.
entries.summary_zh: 桌面角色扮演游戏：DM bot 主持，Cast bot 扮演 NPC 和敌人，Party bot 扮演 AI 队友，你扮演自己的英雄。默认单人，可选多人。
entries.author: Chef

entries.name: Postwright
entries.summary: Turns your week of real work into ready-to-post X drafts in your own voice, with sources, assets and suggested times. Draft-only: you hit post.
entries.summary_zh: 把你一周的真实工作变成用你自己口吻写的 X 草稿，附来源、素材和建议发布时间。只起草，发帖由你按。
entries.author: Calix

entries.name: Chief of Staff Kit
entries.summary: One front door for your bot org: routes work to specialist bots, tracks open items and never acts externally without your approval.
entries.summary_zh: 你的 bot 组织的统一前台：把工作派给专职 bot，跟踪未结事项，未经你批准绝不对外行动。
entries.author: Dennis

entries.name: Stenographer
entries.summary: Keeps a light word-for-word text log of everything your Grok Bots and group chats say, plus each bot's instructions, so your setup can be rebuilt.
entries.summary_zh: 给你所有 Grok Bot 和群聊的发言留一份轻量逐字文本记录，连同每个 bot 的指令，便于在另一个账号里重建整套配置。
entries.author: Andy

entries.name: Streamer Calvin
entries.summary: Supervised live-stream co-producer for X Live, Twitch, YouTube and Kick: helps set up OBS, reads and moderates chat, and drafts replies you approve.
entries.summary_zh: 受你监督的直播副导播，支持 X Live、Twitch、YouTube 和 Kick：帮你设置 OBS，读弹幕、做管理，并起草回复等你批准。
entries.author: Falcon

entries.name: News Bias Meter
entries.summary: Scores news headlines and articles for objectivity on a 1-5 scale, quoting the exact words behind each score, with an optional daily digest of your sources.
entries.summary_zh: 按 1–5 分给新闻标题和文章的客观性打分，并引用每个分数背后的原话；也可每天推送你常看来源的摘要。
entries.author: Denton

entries.name: YouTube Strategy Professor
entries.summary: YouTube strategy tutor: tracks official updates and top strategists daily, sends a sourced digest on packaging, retention, monetization and a daily experiment.
entries.summary_zh: YouTube 策略导师：每天研究官方更新和头部策略师，发来带出处的摘要，涵盖包装、留存、变现，外加一个每日实验。
entries.author: Abdullah

entries.name: Launchpad
entries.summary: App store manager that sets up and maintains your mobile apps on the App Store and Google Play, from first listing to production release.
entries.summary_zh: 应用商店管家：在 App Store 和 Google Play 上为你的移动应用完成从首次上架到正式发布的设置和维护。
entries.author: Fellipe

entries.name: OPSEC
entries.summary: Defensive security bot for small businesses and solo devs: inventories apps, repos, deploys and domains, and reports leaked secrets and misconfigs with fixes.
entries.summary_zh: 给小企业主和独立开发者的防御型安全 bot：盘点应用、仓库、部署和域名，排查泄露的密钥和错误配置，定期用大白话报告并给出具体修法。
entries.author: Jason

entries.name: Rule Manager
entries.summary: Shows the rules and standing instructions your agents follow and where each came from, flagging conflicts, stale rules and holds that spread. Read-only.
entries.summary_zh: 列出你的 agent 遵循的规则和常驻指令及其来源，标出冲突、过时规则和波及其他工作的暂停指令。只读。
entries.author: Michael

entries.name: Phone Caller
entries.summary: Makes real phone calls for you in a natural AI voice, in any language: book a table, check hours, pass on a message. Bring your own Telnyx number and xAI key.
entries.summary_zh: 用自然的 AI 语音替你打真实电话，任何语言都行：订位、问营业时间、转达消息。无需订阅，自带 Telnyx 号码和 xAI key，按用量付费。
entries.author: Walter

entries.name: School Mail Watch
entries.summary: For parents: reads your email for school messages, lists what's needed and when, adds dates to your calendar and sends one short daily summary. Read-only.
entries.summary_zh: 给忙碌的家长：读取邮箱里来自孩子学校的邮件，列出要准备的东西和期限，把日期加进日历，每天发一份简短摘要。只读，不发也不删。
entries.author: Walter

entries.name: Security Watch
entries.summary: Watches your GitHub repos and Vercel projects for newly disclosed vulnerabilities and supply-chain attacks, and reports what actually affects you with fixes.
entries.summary_zh: 盯着你的 GitHub 仓库和 Vercel 项目，留意新披露的漏洞和供应链攻击，只报告真正影响你的部分并给出具体修复方法。默认只扫描和报告。
entries.author: emre

entries.name: FPL Gaffer
entries.summary: Runs your Fantasy Premier League team: deadline reminders, injury news, and sourced transfer, captain and chip advice, making changes only after your yes.
entries.summary_zh: 帮你打理梦幻英超（FPL）球队：截止提醒、伤病消息，以及有出处的转会、队长和芯片建议，你点头后才改阵容。
entries.author: Issah

entries.name: Distro
entries.summary: Publishes your finished podcast or video to YouTube, Spotify, Apple Podcasts, Facebook, X and more, in multiple languages with chapters, then checks each link.
entries.summary_zh: 把做好的播客或视频发布到 YouTube、Spotify、Apple Podcasts、Facebook、X 等平台，支持多语言，带章节和完整元数据，最后逐个核对链接。
entries.author: Bud

entries.name: Sentry Mode
entries.summary: Helps safeguard against the php2shell vulnerability and monitors the situation from official sources on X.
entries.summary_zh: 帮你防范 php2shell 漏洞，并从 X 上的官方来源持续跟进事态。
entries.author: Local

entries.name: Privacy Shield
entries.summary: Gets your household off spam call, text and junk-mail lists: Do Not Call Registry, people-search and data-broker opt-outs, then re-scans for returns.
entries.summary_zh: 让你家脱离骚扰电话、短信和垃圾邮件名单：处理 Do Not Call 登记、人员搜索网站和数据经纪商退出，并定期复查删掉卷土重来的记录。
entries.author: Pravinraj

entries.name: Medical Bill Auditor
entries.summary: Questions every line of your medical bills and EOBs, flags double billing, upcoding and junk fees in a color-coded report, then drafts disputes you approve.
entries.summary_zh: 逐行审查医疗账单和 EOB，在彩色报告里标出重复收费、升级编码和垃圾费用，再起草申诉和降费请求，由你逐条批准。
entries.author: Brian

entries.name: Freelance Invoice Chaser
entries.summary: For freelancers waiting on unpaid invoices: tracks what clients owe, watches Gmail for payments and replies, and drafts calm scheduled reminders for your yes.
entries.summary_zh: 给等回款的自由职业者：跟踪客户欠款，盯 Gmail 里的付款和回复，按设定节奏起草语气平和的催款提醒，等你同意再发。
entries.author: Cristopher

entries.name: 粉丝体检
entries.summary: Follower check-up for X creators: nightly read-only scan of public interactions, sorts followers into gold, silver, one-way and dormant, with upkeep tips.
entries.summary_zh: 给 X 创作者做粉丝体检：每晚只读采集公开互动，分出金牌、银牌、单向、沉睡互关等，并给出维护建议。全程不点赞、关注、发帖或私信。
entries.author: ranger_escape

entries.name: PHP2Shell Patcher and Vuln Scout
entries.summary: Fixes the critical PHP2Shell flaws on your sites or servers and watches trusted security accounts for new critical bugs. Asks before every change.
entries.summary_zh: 修复你网站或服务器上严重的 PHP2Shell 漏洞，并关注可信安全账号发布的新高危漏洞，为你的环境起草修复方案，每次改动前都先询问。
entries.author: Owen

entries.name: Bill Watchdog
entries.summary: Read-only bill watchdog: scans your email and bank/card transactions weekly for price hikes, fees, duplicate charges and forgotten subscriptions, drafts fixes.
entries.summary_zh: 只读的账单和订阅看门狗：每周扫描邮件和银行卡交易，找出涨价、手续费、重复扣款和被遗忘的订阅，并起草处理方案等你批准。
entries.author: Allan

entries.name: Hyper
entries.summary: Tunes your other bots without training a model: turns PDFs, books, YouTube videos and web pages into a searchable knowledge base and cited manual (Portuguese).
entries.summary_zh: 不训练模型也能给你的其他 bot 调优：把 PDF、书、YouTube 视频和网页变成可检索的知识库和带引用的专家手册，交给你选的 bot（葡萄牙语）。
entries.author: Gestao

entries.name: ChangeLens
entries.summary: Give it any place on Earth and get before/after satellite cards in true color and SWIR from free Copernicus Sentinel imagery: shorelines, burn scars.
entries.summary_zh: 给它地球上任意地点，用免费的 Copernicus Sentinel 影像生成真彩色和短波红外前后对比卫星图卡，看海岸线、湖泊、新建工程、火烧迹地、积雪和季节变化。
entries.author: Marshall

entries.name: GoHighLevel Guide
entries.summary: Works inside GoHighLevel as you, for agencies or single businesses: maps pipelines and contacts, does daily CRM work, waits for your yes where you gate it.
entries.summary_zh: 以你的身份在 GoHighLevel 里干活，代理商和单个商家都适用：梳理销售管道和联系人，处理日常 CRM 工作，只在你设了关卡的事上等你确认。
entries.author: Corben

entries.name: Rainmaker
entries.summary: Opportunity agent built like a sports agent: finds roles and gigs you fit, gets you to the hiring manager or a warm intro, tailors pitches and runs follow-ups.
entries.summary_zh: 像顶级体育经纪人一样的机会经纪：找你特别合适的职位和项目，帮你接触招聘经理或拿到引荐，定制每份推介，并跟进到谈判准备。
entries.author: Joash

entries.name: Jobby
entries.summary: Job-search assistant that scans for jobs that fit you, builds tailored application packets and tracks every application. Never applies without your go-ahead.
entries.summary_zh: 求职助手：搜寻适合你的职位，准备定制的申请材料，跟踪每一份申请。未经你同意绝不投递或联系雇主。
entries.author: Rich

entries.name: Meme Maker
entries.summary: Turns your photos, jokes and a built-in library of 100 popular blank meme templates into ready-to-post memes, from captioned classics to cutout mashups.
entries.summary_zh: 用你的照片、段子和内置的 100 个热门空白梗图模板做成可直接发的梗图，从经典配字到抠图拼贴和 AI 生成场景都行。
entries.author: grokshroom

entries.name: Ballot Deep Dive Analyzer
entries.summary: Non-partisan election research: hand it your ballot and it digs into every candidate's record, funding, endorsements and positions from primary sources.
entries.summary_zh: 无党派的选举研究助手：把选票交给它，它用一手资料深挖每位候选人的履历、资金、背书和立场，给出平衡的摘要，不告诉你该投谁。
entries.author: Batch

entries.name: Deep Dive
entries.summary: Deep-research assistant that reads studies, primary documents, news and social posts in full, explains contradictions and says how sure it is.
entries.summary_zh: 深度研究助手：针对任何问题完整阅读研究、一手文件、新闻和社交媒体，解释矛盾之处并说明把握有多大，还会学习你的标准。
entries.author: Warren

entries.name: Personal Shopper
entries.summary: Personal shopper for groceries, big stores and niche shops, working inside your own accounts and buying only after you confirm.
entries.summary_zh: 私人采购：在你自己的账号里买菜、逛大卖场和小众店铺，你确认后才下单。
entries.author: Corben

entries.name: Scrum Master Bot
entries.summary: Scrum Master for your squad: runs standups, grooming, planning and retros on your Jira board, flags blockers and tags you only for real decisions.
entries.summary_zh: 给团队的 Scrum Master：在 Jira 看板上主持站会、梳理、计划和复盘，标出阻碍，只有真正需要决策时才 @你。
entries.author: Ira

entries.name: Herald
entries.summary: Makes you a short color newspaper PDF every morning with your day, weather, local news and top headlines, and emails it only to you.
entries.summary_zh: 每天早上给你做一份简短的彩色报纸 PDF，包含当天日程、天气、本地新闻和头条，只发到你的邮箱。
entries.author: AI_Revolution

entries.name: Small Shop Quality COO
entries.summary: Daily quality rhythm for small ISO 9001, AS9100 or IATF 16949 shops: calibration-due alerts, supplier cert expiry and a weekly KPI digest, drafted for review.
entries.summary_zh: 为小型 ISO 9001、AS9100 或 IATF 16949 工厂跑每日质量节奏：校准到期提醒、供应商证书过期和每周 KPI 摘要，草稿交合格审核人批准。
entries.author: Matt

entries.name: North Star
entries.summary: Keeps one shared source of truth about you: who you are, how you write, your rules and open promises, and reports weekly what's drifting or contradictory.
entries.summary_zh: 维护一份关于你的统一事实来源：你是谁、怎么写作、你的规则和未兑现的承诺，每周报告哪些在走偏、拖延或自相矛盾。
entries.author: Oliver

entries.name: Archivist
entries.summary: Quiet librarian bot that saves your X posts, links, ideas and notes into a searchable archive, keeps a local copy of your bot chats and makes encrypted backups.
entries.summary_zh: 安静的图书管理员 bot：把你的 X 帖子、链接、想法和笔记存进可检索的档案，在本地保存 bot 对话副本，并做加密备份。
entries.author: bigRD73

entries.name: Reverse Engineer
entries.summary: Figures out how any app, website, API or binary works, shows the evidence for every finding, and rebuilds a working version for Windows, macOS or Linux.
entries.summary_zh: 弄清任何应用、网站、API 或二进制文件的工作原理，为每个发现给出证据，并重建一个能在 Windows、macOS 或 Linux 上运行的版本。
entries.author: monokern

entries.name: KYB - Coach
entries.summary: Know Your Business coach: interviews you, researches your company's website, investor relations, news and social media, and builds a one-shot intensive course.
entries.summary_zh: “了解你的公司”教练：先采访你，再研究公司官网、投资者关系、新闻和社交媒体，做一门把公司战略和你日常工作连起来的速成课。
entries.author: Alexandre

entries.name: Budgie
entries.summary: Budget bot that keeps your budget in a local SQLite database, plans each paycheck, and forecasts debt payoff, assets and net worth on a live dashboard Page.
entries.summary_zh: 预算 bot：把预算存在本地 SQLite 数据库里，规划每笔工资，并在实时仪表盘页面上预测还债进度、资产和净资产。
entries.author: Cill

entries.name: Roast My Account Bot
entries.summary: Give it any X handle and it makes a vertical roast clip from that account's real posts, with a narrator, Beavis and Butt-Head reactions and meme cutaways.
entries.summary_zh: 给它任意 X 账号，它用该账号的真实帖子做一段竖屏吐槽短片，配解说、Beavis and Butt-Head 式反应、梗图插播和“You've been ROASTED”片尾。
entries.author: Mav

entries.name: Pennie Tester
entries.summary: Passive web security scanner for consultants and security teams: checks sites for OWASP Top 10 weaknesses, no exploits unless you confirm written permission.
entries.summary_zh: 给顾问和安全团队的被动式网站安全扫描器：检查你指定的网站是否有 OWASP Top 10 等弱点，除非你确认有书面授权，否则不跑漏洞利用。
entries.author: Debra

entries.name: The Tiebreaker
entries.summary: Give it a hard call: it argues both sides harder than you can, then drops the act, says what it really thinks and gives a shareable verdict card.
entries.summary_zh: 拿不定主意？把难题交给它：它先替正反两方全力辩论，然后摘下面具说出真实看法，并给出一张可分享的裁决卡。
entries.author: Si

entries.name: Vulnerability Hunter
entries.summary: Finds real trust-boundary vulnerabilities in codebases and owned environments: recon, coverage-led hunting, adversarial validation and target-neutral reports.
entries.summary_zh: 在代码库和自有环境里找真实的信任边界漏洞，多阶段审计流程：侦察、按覆盖率排查、对抗式验证，最后出与目标无关的报告。
entries.author: Lonny

entries.name: Don't Panic Lite
entries.summary: Cozy desk buddy that times your tea and coffee, nudges you to drink water and reminds you to take gentle stretch breaks during work hours.
entries.summary_zh: 温馨的桌边伙伴：给你的茶和咖啡计时，提醒你喝水，并在工作时间提醒你做轻松的拉伸休息。
entries.author: joy

entries.name: Playlist Builder
entries.summary: Turns your Spotify Liked Songs into curated playlists by genre, mood and energy, and tells you what your taste says about you.
entries.summary_zh: 把你 Spotify 里的“已点赞歌曲”按流派、情绪和能量整理成精选歌单，还告诉你你的口味说明了什么。
entries.author: Kolby

entries.name: What's New
entries.summary: Sends you the latest Grok Bot release notes and the newest "What's new in Grok Bot" video when you add it, then checks every morning for anything new.
entries.summary_zh: 添加后立即发来最新的 Grok Bot 更新说明和最新一期“What's new in Grok Bot”视频，之后每天早上检查并推送新内容。
entries.author: Matt

entries.name: Penny DOGE
entries.summary: Finds where your Grok Bot fleet wastes usage and ranks the fixes, from a weekly scan or a pasted Usage screenshot. Only recommends, never edits your other bots.
entries.summary_zh: 找出你的 Grok Bot 团队在哪里浪费用量并给修复排序，可每周自动扫描，也可直接用你贴的 Usage 截图或例程列表。只建议，不改其他 bot。
entries.author: Bowie

entries.name: List Front Page
entries.summary: Paste any X list and get a news front page of top stories, links and voices, refreshed hourly. Never posts.
entries.summary_zh: 贴入任意 X 列表，得到一份由热门话题、链接和发声者组成的新闻头版，每小时刷新。从不发帖。
entries.author: Thuong

entries.name: Flight Turbulence Report
entries.summary: Sends a turbulence report with a table and route map an hour before every flight on your calendar, using SIGMETs, AIRMETs, PIREPs and Turbli.
entries.summary_zh: 在日历里每趟航班起飞前一小时发来颠簸报告，附表格和航线图，飞行中也可随时查询，数据来自 SIGMET、AIRMET、PIREP 和 Turbli。
entries.author: Dan

entries.name: Mika
entries.summary: App-builder teammate that takes your idea from spec to a tested, working build with a solid agent harness, and asks before anything is pushed or deployed.
entries.summary_zh: 友好的 AI 应用搭建队友：用扎实的 agent 框架把你的想法从规格做到测试通过、能运行的版本，推送或部署前都先问你。
entries.author: David

entries.name: True Circle
entries.summary: Makes an X inner-circle image of the people you really interact with, after short onboarding for flavor, window, theme and leave-outs. Needs the X plugin.
entries.summary_zh: 生成一张你在 X 上真正互动的人组成的“核心圈”图片，先简短引导你选风格、时间范围、主题和排除对象。需要 X 插件。
entries.author: Jay

entries.name: Appealinator
entries.summary: Checks county and MCP records on your property assessment and drafts an appeal if there are savings to be had.
entries.summary_zh: 核对县里和 MCP 的房产评估记录，如果有省钱空间就为你起草估值申诉。
entries.author: Brett

entries.name: Brújula
entries.summary: ADHD-friendly personal coach that keeps your tasks and money on track with tiny next steps, gentle daily check-ins and a simple weekly money check.
entries.summary_zh: 适合 ADHD 人群的私人教练：用很小的下一步、温和的每日打卡和简单的每周财务检查，让你的任务和钱都不跑偏。
entries.author: Steven

entries.name: PHP Vulnerability Checker
entries.summary: Scans your Linux, Windows and macOS computers and Docker containers for PHP versions hit by the latest security bugs, explains the risk, patches on your say-so.
entries.summary_zh: 扫描你的 Linux、Windows、macOS 电脑和 Docker 容器，找出受最新安全漏洞影响的 PHP 版本，解释风险，经你同意后安全打补丁。
entries.author: Jonathan

entries.name: Hermes
entries.summary: Operations architect for a team of AI bots: works out the lanes your work needs, gives each bot one specialty, home folder and inbox, maps where things live.
entries.summary_zh: 给 AI bot 团队的运营架构师：理清你的工作需要哪些分工，给每个 bot 一个专长、主文件夹和收件箱，并维护一张清晰的资料位置图。
entries.author: Krista

entries.name: Salesforce Guide
entries.summary: Works inside your Salesforce org as you: connects step by step, handles daily pipeline, lead, account and case work, and sends a daily brief.
entries.summary_zh: 以你的身份在 Salesforce 里干活：一步步帮你连上，然后处理日常管道、线索、客户和工单工作，发每日简报，哪些事要等你确认由你定。
entries.author: Corben

entries.name: Sentinel
entries.summary: Infosec news watcher for engineers and SREs: watches X for new CVEs, zero-days, exploited bugs, breaches and supply-chain hits, corroborates, then alerts.
entries.summary_zh: 给工程师和 SRE 的安全资讯哨兵：全天盯 X 上的新 CVE、零日、在野利用、重大泄露和供应链攻击，核实后再报警，另有按你技术栈定制的每日摘要。
entries.author: Morgan

entries.name: Business Incubator
entries.summary: Brainstorming partner for side hustles and small businesses a Grok Bot could run nearly hands-off: builds out ideas, checks competitors and pricing.
entries.summary_zh: 帮你构思几乎可以交给 Grok Bot 放手运营的副业和小生意：完善想法、调研竞品和定价，并维护一份持续更新的点子清单。
entries.author: Rob

entries.name: The Legislator
entries.summary: Watchdog on new US federal bills and rules: alerts you when something that touches you moves, explains it plainly and helps draft letters and public comments.
entries.summary_zh: 盯美国联邦新法案和新规：与你相关的有进展就提醒，用大白话解释，并帮你起草信件和公众意见，发送前都由你批准。
entries.author: Jose

entries.name: Art Bot
entries.summary: Artist and creative director that turns your brands into style guides, on-brand images, animations, video edits with music, decks and design critiques.
entries.summary_zh: 艺术家兼创意总监：把你的品牌做成风格指南、贴合品牌的图片、动画、配乐视频剪辑、演示文稿和设计点评，花钱或发布前先问你。
entries.author: Michael

entries.name: Fed Indicator Bot
entries.summary: Tracks real-time private economic data like ADP, card spending, job postings, online prices and mobility to read where the Fed is headed. Weekly summaries.
entries.summary_zh: 跟踪 ADP、刷卡消费、招聘信息、线上价格和出行等实时民间经济数据以及 AI 和生产率信号，判断美联储可能走向，每周总结并在政策相关变化时提醒。
entries.author: A.M.

entries.name: Smart Shopper
entries.summary: Price-drop sniper and gift finder for any store: watches prices daily with shipping and tax included, finds gifts by arrive-by date, never buys without your OK.
entries.summary_zh: 适用任何商店的降价狙击手和礼物参谋：每天盯含运费和税的价格，按送达日期找真正合适的礼物，没有你的同意绝不下单。
entries.author: JP

entries.name: Wingman
entries.summary: Your wingman across every account: it keeps watch, builds its own shortcuts and keeps small promises.
entries.summary_zh: 跨所有账号的僚机助手：帮你盯着动静，自己搭建捷径，记得兑现小承诺。
entries.author: Corben

entries.name: Beeper Bot
entries.summary: Reads your Beeper chats (WhatsApp, Telegram, Signal, X DMs, Slack and more), tells you what matters and drafts replies in your voice. Read-only by default.
entries.summary_zh: 读取你的 Beeper 聊天（WhatsApp、Telegram、Signal、X 私信、Slack 等），告诉你哪些重要，并用你的口吻起草回复。默认只读。
entries.author: Joe

entries.name: Printy
entries.summary: 3D print bot: takes print ideas, designs printable parts, builds slicer-ready files, keeps material lists and troubleshoots failed prints. Asks before printing.
entries.summary_zh: 3D 打印助手：接收打印想法，设计可打印零件，生成可直接切片的文件，记录耗材清单，排查打印失败。开打前先征得你同意。
entries.author: John

entries.name: Sports Fan Desk
entries.summary: Personal sports research desk for pro, college and school sports: follow your teams, learn in Fan, Analyst or Quant mode, sourced analysis, no fake predictions.
entries.summary_zh: 个人体育研究台，覆盖职业、大学和校队赛事：关注你的球队，可选球迷、分析师或量化模式，分析附出处，不编比分不瞎预测。
entries.author: Ashley

entries.name: VA Claims Helper
entries.summary: Patient, plain-talking helper for veterans: organizes VA claims, writes personal and buddy statements, gathers records and tracks appointments and deadlines.
entries.summary_zh: 耐心、说大白话的退伍军人助手：整理 VA 理赔，撰写个人陈述和战友证明，收集记录，跟踪预约和截止日期。
entries.author: Antilitist

entries.name: Document & Training Control Assistant
entries.summary: Keeps a small ISO 9001/AS9100/IATF 16949 shop's documents and training in order: revision logs, plain procedures, training matrix. Drafts for your reviewer.
entries.summary_zh: 帮 ISO 9001、AS9100、IATF 16949 小工厂管好文件和培训：修订记录、通俗作业程序、按岗位的培训矩阵和培训效果检查，草稿交合格审核人把关。
entries.author: Matt

entries.name: FAI Assistant
entries.summary: Organizes a first article inspection package from drawings: characteristic list, ballooning checklist, Form 1–3 structure, delta FAI scope. For aerospace shops.
entries.summary_zh: 根据图纸整理首件检验（FAI）资料包：特性清单、标注气球检查表、Form 1–3 结构、部分或增量 FAI 范围。面向小型航空航天工厂，由合格检验员核对。
entries.author: Matt

entries.name: Internal Audit Assistant
entries.summary: Plans risk-based internal audits for small AS9100/ISO quality teams: schedules, checklists, interview questions, evidence logs, findings and report drafts.
entries.summary_zh: 为小型 AS9100/ISO 质量团队规划基于风险的内审：审核计划、检查表、访谈问题、证据记录、发现项和报告草稿，均交合格人员复核。
entries.author: Matt

entries.name: Relationship Repair Coach
entries.summary: Helps you break the cycle you two keep falling into and make things right after a fight, even if only you show up. Coaching for adults 18+, not therapy.
entries.summary_zh: 帮你打破两人反复陷入的循环，吵架后学会修复关系，哪怕只有你一个人来。面向 18 岁以上成年人，是教练辅导，不是心理治疗。
entries.author: Deyder

entries.name: Sponsor Hunter
entries.summary: Helps creators find flat-fee sponsors for a newsletter or X account: media kit from real stats, brands that fit, short fixed-price pitches and one follow-up.
entries.summary_zh: 帮创作者给 newsletter 或 X 账号找固定费用赞助：用真实数据做媒体资料包，匹配合适品牌，写简短的定价提案，再礼貌跟进一次。
entries.author: Karata

entries.name: Connector Scope Check
entries.summary: Before connecting Gmail, Drive, Stripe, GitHub or calendar to a Grok Bot, runs a minimum-scope checklist and returns CLEAR or NEEDS ACTION. Never connects.
entries.summary_zh: 在给 Grok Bot 接入 Gmail、Drive、Stripe、GitHub 或日历之前（或刚添加模板后），跑一遍最小权限检查清单，给出 CLEAR 或 NEEDS ACTION。自己从不连接。
entries.author: Umashankar

entries.name: Creator Pay Desk
entries.summary: Checklist for Grok Bot Creator Rewards readiness: public bot links, link-posts per pay period, X Money status, listing hygiene and retention nudges. Draft-only.
entries.summary_zh: Grok Bot 创作者奖励准备清单：公开 bot 链接、每个结算周期的链接帖、X Money 状态、上架信息整洁度和留存提醒。只出草稿。
entries.author: Umashankar

entries.name: Political Spam Blocker
entries.summary: Clears political and election spam from your inbox, gets you off campaign lists, can auto-reply STOP to political texts and helps shut off campaign calls.
entries.summary_zh: 清理收件箱里的政治和选举垃圾邮件，帮你退出竞选邮件列表，可自动回复 STOP 给政治短信，并协助屏蔽竞选电话。
entries.author: Sawyer

entries.name: .promo
entries.summary: Makes keynote-style launch and promo videos for any product from chat or a one-tap builder Page: stills first for approval, then the full MP4, no watermark.
entries.summary_zh: 在聊天里或一键生成页面里，为任何产品制作发布会风格的宣传视频：先出静帧给你确认，再出完整 MP4，无水印。
entries.author: greedfi

entries.name: The HR Guy
entries.summary: Back-office HR helper for owners of small unattended shops with 2–10 hourly staff: onboarding, training, store checklists, approvals with 48-hour escalation.
entries.summary_zh: 给 2–10 名小时工的无人值守小店老板的后台 HR 助手：入职、培训、门店检查清单、审批及 48 小时升级提醒。仅供参考，非法律意见。
entries.author: Ken

entries.name: Hugo Sánchez
entries.summary: Loyal, proactive Gmail and Google Calendar assistant: triages your inbox, adds confirmations to your calendar, catches conflicts, sends a short morning brief.
entries.summary_zh: 忠诚又主动的 Gmail 和 Google 日历助手：整理收件箱，把确认邮件加进日历，发现日程冲突，每早发简短简报；未经你同意绝不发邮件。
entries.author: Enrique

entries.name: Pantry Pal
entries.summary: Friendly pantry clerk that turns your recipes, pantry, grocery receipts and stores' real weekly sale ads into shopping lists and meal plans.
entries.summary_zh: 友好的食品柜管家：把你的食谱、库存、购物小票和超市每周真实促销广告变成购物清单和膳食计划。
entries.author: bEastTennesseean

entries.name: Security Watch
entries.summary: Helps secure what you use online, from a laptop or WordPress site to a server stack: maps it, checks each layer zero-trust style, walks you through each fix.
entries.summary_zh: 帮你保护在线使用的一切，从一台笔记本、一个 WordPress 站点到整套服务器：梳理资产，按零信任逐层检查，只报真正影响你的问题并一步步教你修。
entries.author: Luca

entries.name: Deal Hunter
entries.summary: Watches marketplaces and web stores, new and used, for deals on anything you want to buy, and pings you only when a price really drops.
entries.summary_zh: 盯着各类二手和全新商品的市场与网店，帮你找想买东西的好价，只在价格真降时才提醒你。
entries.author: William

entries.name: Steve
entries.summary: Kid-safe Minecraft Bedrock teammate that joins your family's world on its own account: follows, mines what you name, builds on request, guards kids from mobs.
entries.summary_zh: 儿童安全的 Minecraft 基岩版队友：用自己的账号加入你家的世界，跟随、按你说的挖矿、按需建造，还会保护孩子不被敌对生物伤害。
entries.author: Carl

entries.name: Meerkat, Safety Alerts Near You
entries.summary: Checks trusted local sources for dangers near you and places on your calendar, names each warning's source and stays quiet when all is well. Calendar read-only.
entries.summary_zh: 根据你的位置查看可信的本地信息源，提醒附近的危险，可读取日历检查你要去的地方；每条警告注明来源，平安无事时保持安静。日历只读不改。
entries.author: Defender

entries.name: Tripwire
entries.summary: Shared security watcher for your team: finds incidents that could touch what you run, checks whether you're actually exposed and fixes what it safely can.
entries.summary_zh: 团队共享的安全哨兵：发现可能波及你们所用系统的安全事件，核实是否真的受影响，并安全地修复能修的部分。
entries.author: Robert

entries.name: Vuln Scout
entries.summary: Tracks public CVE and patch advisories for defensive awareness, with short digests on Pages.
entries.summary_zh: 跟踪公开的 CVE 和补丁公告，用于防御性预警，并在 Pages 上发布简短摘要。
entries.author: Nick

entries.name: Recipes For My Dragon Flaps
entries.summary: Friendly recipe helper that gives clear, practical recipes and adapts them to your diet, like vegan, vegetarian or make-ahead meals.
entries.summary_zh: 友好的食谱助手：给出清晰实用的菜谱，并按你的饮食需求调整，比如纯素、素食或提前备餐。
entries.author: Michelle

entries.name: Creative Video Studio
entries.summary: Warm, creative video teammate that turns your phone clips into finished videos and makes AI video too. No editing experience needed.
entries.summary_zh: 温暖又有创意的视频搭档：把你的手机片段剪成成片，也能生成 AI 视频，无需任何剪辑经验。
entries.author: Mars

entries.name: Mission Control
entries.summary: Fleet operations board for your Grok Bots: audits every bot daily, flags red/yellow/green, forecasts plan burn, sends a dashboard and PDF of token-saving tips.
entries.summary_zh: 你的 Grok Bot 舰队运营看板：每天审计每个 bot，标出红黄绿状态，预测套餐消耗，交付仪表盘和 PDF，附具体的省 token 建议。
entries.author: AVENTUS

entries.name: pump.fun dev check
entries.summary: Reads dev history and holdings via pumpdata.fun. Limited free access; optional email/key signup with consent. No trades or pump.fun affiliation.
entries.summary_zh: 通过 pumpdata.fun 读取开发者历史和早期持仓。免费接口有限额；可选邮箱/API key 注册需先获同意。不交易，与 pump.fun 无关联。
entries.author: pumpdata.fun

entries.name: pump.fun daily
entries.summary: Each morning sends yesterday's pump.fun launches, graduations, volume, busiest coins and odds, via pumpdata.fun. Free, read-only. Not affiliated with pump.fun.
entries.summary_zh: 每天早上发送 pump.fun 昨日概况，包括发币数、毕业数、交易量、最活跃的币和各市值段的概率，数据来自 pumpdata.fun 免费接口。免费使用，只读，不交易。与 pump.fun 无关联。
entries.author: pumpdata.fun
